validationNotes: Expo Clipboard web legacySetString returns true even if execCommand returns false. The new page uses the browser rejecting clipboard API directly; actual success and explicit denial were tested.
The new share label checker measures every non-whitespace glyph. Chromium adds an invisible soft-wrap-space Range box beyond its text container; that is not label clipping.

After intentional navigation to another printed page, the original-path DOM identity snapshot is renewed; a new page naturally has new nodes. Pinch, hold, Focus toggles and rotation on the same page retain nodes.

One preliminary zoom/media run observed playCalls 2 versus 1 with an unchanged source. Cause was not established. Four instrumented isolated reruns and the final instrumented full 8-context suite did not reproduce it; final actual source/time/play-call observations are retained above. No unrelated audio runtime was changed.
limitations: Hermes exports are not installed Android/iOS builds or device gesture/share-sheet QA.
Native PanResponder/ScrollView arbitration, OEM system gestures, real camera scanning, OS Back, screen readers and physical-device performance still need device QA.
Native share outcomes do not prove message delivery; the UI makes no delivery-success claim.
OpenCV decoding of 49 rendered QR screenshots is not a claim that every physical camera or Play Store listing availability was tested.
Browser inset fixtures and source clocks are not native navigation-mode or audible-gap benchmarks.
Translation copy coverage is not professional linguistic review.
The isolated preliminary extra-Play observation remains an unconfirmed validation anomaly, not a claimed diagnosed/fixed audio defect.
No app deployment, store upload or release configuration change. Tajweed and Mufahras remain deferred.
